sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Pressing an action button a second time still reloads the page (that is what keeps the column filters working), but the reloaded page now runs the same button by itself: no more "⚠️ Page Reloaded" dialog to dismiss and button to press again. A short note beside the status line ("↻ Page reloaded — re-running …") says what is happening and fades after about 3 seconds. The dialog remains only as a fallback when the button cannot be found again.

The reload now happens before anything else a press does. It used to come after the other sections had already been removed from the visible page and, on an artist's release groups, after a whole pass of page requests for the official headers, all of which the reload then threw away.
